intro:
The practical details behind every quote and every project — pricing, files, payment, and how your renders can be used and shared.

Last updated: 5th August 2026

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: These Terms apply to all work carried out by Visualise New Zealand. By instructing us to proceed — whether in writing, verbally, or by providing files or a brief — the Client agrees to be bound by the version of these Terms current at that time. The current version is always available at visualisenz.com/terms.html

sections.heading: Who We Work For
sections.body: Our engagement is with the party who instructs us and is invoiced for our work (the "Client") — typically, though not limited to, an architect, interior designer, property developer, building company, or real estate agent — regardless of any contact we may have with the Client's own customers or stakeholders. Only the Client may instruct, approve, or authorise our work, and only the Client is responsible for payment, regardless of the Client's own arrangements with anyone else.

sections.heading: Scope of Work
sections.body: We provide concept design visualisation services, typically used at the early stages of a design or project. Our engagement is limited to the agreed deliverables, and concludes on delivery — regardless of how the Client's broader project subsequently proceeds.

sections.heading: Basis of Engagement & Pricing
sections.body:
Where the Client would like a fixed price quote, this should be requested and agreed before work begins. Where no fixed price quote has been requested and agreed, work will instead be carried out and invoiced on an hourly basis at our current hourly rate.

Fixed price packages are based on two sets of amendments (one consolidated round of feedback per set) and up to four images per room. If work is required beyond the fixed price scope, the Client will be advised and may be charged an additional fixed price or at the current hourly rate.

Amendments within a fixed price package cover simple changes, including changes to materials, finishes, and minor 3D modelling adjustments. More complex 3D modelling changes — such as exploring additional design or layout options — are not included, and may be charged as an additional fixed price or at the current hourly rate. Walk-through or promotional videos are also available on request, at additional cost.

Rates applicable to an engagement are those current when work begins, unless a quote states otherwise. Pricing may need to be negotiated for more complex projects. Quotes are valid for 30 days from the date specified on the quote. Visualise New Zealand is not currently required to register for or pay GST; pricing may change as and when this becomes a requirement.

sections.heading: Supplying Your Own Files
sections.body: Please note that if you are supplying a 3D model, the quality of the model has a direct impact on the quality of the photo-realistic render, and some CAD software is not compatible with the software that we use.

sections.heading: Invoicing & Payment
sections.body: Invoices are generated on completion of a single job. Monthly invoicing is available for larger ongoing projects, by prior arrangement. Payment is due within 7 days of invoice date, unless alternative arrangements have been made. Full payment is required before visualisations can be used, shared, or published. Payment is owed by the Client regardless of the Client's own arrangements, approvals, or payment terms with any other party. Interest may be charged on any overdue balance at 1.5% per month, calculated from the due date until payment is received in full.

sections.heading: Conceptual Designs & Approvals
sections.body: Our 3D visualisations are conceptual designs only and may differ from the final building construction. Please ensure that your clients & stakeholders are aware of this. Approval must be obtained from all relevant stakeholders (including any intellectual property holders) prior to any use or publication of the 3D visualisations. Visualise New Zealand is not responsible for obtaining approval from relevant stakeholders or intellectual property holders. Visualise New Zealand reserves the right to publish any and all completed 3D visuals online, for marketing purposes (or any other reason), unless explicitly agreed otherwise.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property & Credit
sections.body: The renders created by Visualise New Zealand remain the intellectual property of Visualise New Zealand. The Client (including their suppliers and clients) are welcome to share these renders on social media or other digital platforms, provided that @visualisenz is tagged or credited in the post or caption. Likewise, when Visualise New Zealand shares renders featuring a client's design or project, we will tag or credit the client's business to acknowledge their intellectual property.

sections.heading: Updates to These Terms
sections.body: These Terms may be updated at any time. The version current as at the date work begins, applies to that engagement. The current version, along with its last-updated date, is always available at visualisenz.com/terms.html
